description: 稼働中 / Active — AS-IS M_ACCOUNT.STATUS_CD 'A' → TO-BE account.status 'ACTIVE'
解約済 / Closed — AS-IS M_ACCOUNT.STATUS_CD 'C' → TO-BE account.status 'CLOSED'
凍結中 / Frozen — AS-IS M_ACCOUNT.STATUS_CD 'F' → TO-BE account.status 'FROZEN'
保留中 / Pending — AS-IS M_ACCOUNT.STATUS_CD 'P' → TO-BE account.status 'PENDING'
